quote: I recently bought 400 r1 bismuth and prospected that to get pebbles and glass.
notes: Commenter reports buying 400 rank-1 Bismuth and receiving 22 Glittering Glass, plus enough Pebbles for 110 Marbled Stones; pebble count not stated. Shaping main node and Glass/Stone nodes reportedly maxed; exact skill, refunds, reuse and completed casts absent. Purchased 400 ore is NOT an independently measured 80 casts. Pre-Oct30 byproduct hotfix. Do not convert 110 crafted stones to a pebble count.
